about.en: PayAI Network is a payments project for AI agents and apps that runs an x402 payment facilitator and a marketplace in which agents hire and pay each other on Solana. PAYAI is the SPL mint PAYmo6moDF3Ro3X6bU2jwe2UdBnBhv8YjLgL1j4DxGu, which replaced the project's earlier pump.fun mint E7NgL19JbN8BhUDgWjkH8MtnbhJoaGaWJqosxZZepump.
